story.subtitle: OUR IDENTITY
story.title: New Life For Vietnamese Heritage
story.desc: Ancient Craft New Essence is a project combining traditional handicrafts and modern technology — bringing the stories of Vietnamese craft villages closer to everyone.
story.pillar1_desc: Each 3D diorama is not just a decoration — it's a story about the craft village, the artisan, and their lifelong dedication. You own a masterpiece, you keep a cultural memory.
story.pillar2_desc: From the hands of Bat Trang potters, Van Phuc silk looms to Quang Phu Cau incense kilns — we capture and recreate every manual step through models and vivid AR experiences.
story.pillar3_desc: Dive deep into the history, people, and spirit of 5 famous Vietnamese craft villages. Each village page is a journey — from origins, processes to unique characteristics found nowhere else.

vision.desc: Ancient Craft New Essence aims to become a leading creative cultural brand, contributing to bringing the heritage of Vietnamese traditional craft villages closer to the public through modern interactive experiences, awakening love and pride in national cultural identity.

mission.title: Mission
mission.desc: Preserving and spreading the quintessence of Vietnamese traditional craft villages by creating cultural products combining technology, helping heritage to be approached in a friendly, attractive, and suitable way for contemporary life.

authenticity.title: Cultural Authenticity
authenticity.subtitle: Preserving cultural identity
authenticity.desc: Respecting and preserving the original values of Vietnamese traditional craft villages, ensuring each product and experience truly reflects the cultural identity and quintessence.

innovation.title: Innovation

learning.title: Cultural Learning

community.title: Community Connection

sustainability.title: Sustainability

regulations.title: Policies
regulations.desc: Overview of policies, terms, and shopping guidelines

items.heading: Delivery Coverage
items.body: We deliver models nationwide from North to South. Delivery time in inner Hanoi is within 24 hours, other provinces from 3 to 5 working days.

items.heading: Shipping Fee
items.body: Fixed shipping fee of 30,000₫ per order nationwide. Free shipping for orders over 1,500,000₫.

items.heading: Protective Packaging
items.body: Each diorama box is carefully wrapped in shock-absorbing foam and sealed in multiple layers to prevent shaking and cracking during transit. The outer protective mica has an additional anti-scratch film.

items.heading: Order Tracking
items.body: Once the order is confirmed for shipping, you will receive an email with a tracking number to follow your package journey in real-time.

items.heading: Return Period
items.body: Diorama models can be returned within 7 days from successful delivery. Returned products must be intact, without cracks on the protective mica layer, and without scratches on the wooden frame.

items.heading: Return Conditions
items.body: Products must have intact labels, unused, and include all accessories. Photos of the product condition upon receipt are recommended as evidence if needed.

items.heading: Return Shipping Fee
items.body: For returns due to customer preference, the shipping cost will be borne by the customer. If the model has manufacturing defects or is damaged during shipping, we will cover the return shipping fee entirely.

items.heading: Refund Time
items.body: After receiving and inspecting the returned product, we will process the refund within 5–7 working days via your original payment method.

items.heading: Materials and Crafting
items.body: All diorama models use premium acrylic mica, 3D printed resin details, and hand-painted acrylics. Each product undergoes quality checking before packaging.

items.heading: Dimensional Tolerance
items.body: Due to the handmade nature of the product, there may be slight dimensional tolerances (±2mm) and minor color variations compared to website images due to photography lighting conditions.

items.heading: Warranty
items.body: Products have a 3-month warranty for frame structure defects, or QR connection errors. The warranty does not cover damage caused by impact, moisture, or improper use.

items.heading: Payment Methods
items.body: We support payment via VNPAY (domestic ATM cards, Visa/Mastercard international cards), bank transfers, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for orders under 3,000,000₫.

items.heading: Information Security
items.body: All payment transactions are encrypted using SSL standards. We do not store customer payment card information on our systems.

items.heading: Order Confirmation
items.body: An order confirmation email will be sent immediately upon successful payment. If you don't receive the email within 15 minutes, please check your spam folder or contact us.

items.heading: Information Collection
items.body: We only collect necessary information for processing orders and improving user experience: full name, delivery address, email, and contact phone number.

items.heading: Information Usage
items.body: Your personal information is used to process orders, send delivery notifications, and support customers. We do not sell or share information with third parties for commercial purposes.

items.heading: Customer Rights
items.body: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting our support email.

items.heading: How to activate AR?
items.body: Scan the QR code on the product base with your phone camera, the browser will open the AR page immediately without needing an app. Requires iOS 12+ or Android 8+ with AR-supported cameras.

items.heading: Can I place bulk orders (B2B)?
items.body: Yes. We support bulk orders for businesses and organizations with preferential pricing policies and the ability to print logos/branding upon request. Contact our email for a consultation.

items.heading: How to preserve the product?
items.body: Avoid direct sunlight and high heat sources. Use a soft damp cloth to gently wipe the outer mica layer. Avoid humid environments to protect the frame. Do not disassemble the miniature details inside.
